messages:
arya: Partner SI reported repeated worker crashes on AMD MI250 after vendor image bumped ROCm to 5.8 this morning. Throughput dropped ~35% and a few jobs reported kernel aborts. Ticket: https://partner.example.com/rocm-1543

 tom: Can you paste the sanitized stderr and which models/batches?

 arya: Snippet from partner (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-22T07:12:01Z] runtime ERROR: rocm_kern: illegal memory access detected
[2026-03-22T07:12:01Z] worker WARN: falling back to CPU path; latency x3
[2026-03-22T07:12:01Z] worker ERROR: inference aborted: hipErrorIllegalAddress
```
Model family: quantized 8B; batches 1-4; dynamic KV cache enabled.

 kevin: We repro'd on our integration MI250 nodes with vendor image. Failures cluster on a specific ROCm runtime ABI; looks like fused kernels built with older HIP flags are incompatible with 5.8 checks.

 marketplace-bot: Marketplace action queued: set rocm_pin=5.7 for listing 'partner-solution-llm' (scoped pin). Estimated canary rollout in ~3h.

 kevin: Short-term plan: scope pin to the listing, add a runtime guard to disable fused fast-paths on ROCm >=5.8, and run cross-driver matrix (5.6,5.7,5.8) across MI250 variants. Will open PR `fix/rocm-fused-guard` (ETA 48h).

 tom: Action items:
- tom: confirm marketplace pin + canary and get partner signoff (ETA 3h)
- kevin: matrix runs + logs (ETA tonight)
- kevin: runtime guarded fallback PR (ETA 48h)
- arya: partner-facing note: pinning + investigation, no public comms (ETA 1h)

 partner-rep: Thanks, we'll run the canary and report results. Please include a small smoke script to validate ROCm version before image acceptance.

 arya: Agreed. kevin, can you add `hipcc --version` + a tiny kernel-dispatch smoke command to the gating script?

 kevin: Yep — will add `hipcc --version && ./bin/runtime-rocm-smoke --model tiny-8b --iters 5` to marketplace gating.

 arya: Good. Keeping updates here; ping me if partner escalates or if canary shows regressions. :thumbsup:
